versions.changelog:
Initial release of it-searching skill:

- Provides an IT-focused search agent with access to url_scraping and arxiv_search tools.
- Includes a curated list of major tech company blog URLs for direct access to official updates.
- Outlines clear tool usage rules for retrieving recent AI papers and company news.
- Offers guidance on template variables and agent configuration for runtime usage.
- Ensures up-to-date results by instructing users to read actual web content.
